name: Wall-Supported Split Squat

instructions.description: Stand in a split stance beside a wall and place fingertips lightly on it for balance.
Lower straight down by bending both knees while keeping the torso tall.
Pause briefly with most of the weight on the front leg and the front knee aligned over the foot.
Press through the feet to rise and repeat before switching sides.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use the wall only for balance assistance.

variations.variationDescription: Related single-leg strength pattern performed in a fixed split stance with support.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Remove support and add stepping for a more dynamic variation.

commentsNotes: Avoid leaning heavily into the wall.
